'''2001 Arizona State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held at Gamerz Edge, Phoenix, AZ on 14 April 2001. [[DJ Andrews]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2082">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Gamerz Edge, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 30
* '''Winner:''' [[DJ Andrews]]
